board: TinkeringTech HDC2080 TI Humidity & Temperature Sensor Breakout (5-pin: 3.3V, INT, SCL, SDA, GND)
reason: Check passed on ESP32 and Pico on the first run. The model uses 8-bit auto-incrementing registers with LSB-first 14-bit T/RH words (low 2 bits zero), TI's T = raw/2^16*165-40.5 and RH = raw/2^16*100, plus the ID registers; the driver checks the IDs, triggers an on-demand measurement via 0x0F = 0x01, waits 10 ms and reads 4 bytes from 0x00.
